early.name: Restorative Shot
early.annotation: No brainer since even NPCs heal you now.

mid.name: Spirit Snatch
mid.annotation: Core item. You deal spirit damage with your 2, steal 12% of their spirit res.

mid.name: Healbane
mid.annotation: When you use your 2 on your enemy you apply healing reduction because of Spirit Strike/Snatch. By doing this you make sure that they don't heal too much when you are charging your 1.

mid.name: Hunter's Aura
mid.annotation: Since all of your fights are going to be in close range

late.name: Mystic Reverb
late.annotation: Key item for your 1. You are going to lose some hp while charging the ability. This makes sure that you get some HP back after hitting the target. Greatly increases survivability. Also you apply slow.

late.name: Crushing Fists
late.annotation: If you have enough souls left and the game is far from being over.

late.name: Colossus
late.annotation: Maximum Survivability. Activate this as soon as you reach below 50% hp. You need to last as long as possible before using your Ult.

late.name: Spirit Burn
late.annotation: If Healing Bane is not enough.

late.name: Refresher
late.annotation: With the amount of incoming damage late game. You will be needing this for your ult in order to last longer in fights.

picks.name: Refresher
